candidates.description: This feature vector represents traditional German given names and German-language proper noun stems.
This vector represents common Spanish noun suffixes related to action, state, or result, particularly those ending in "-ción" and its variants.
Spanish indefinite adjectives and determiners that express quantity, identity, or distribution.
This vector represents common Spanish action verbs in their infinitive form.
This feature vector activates on tokens containing the prefix or letters "exp", capturing common abbreviations and root words associated with expansion, experience, and expression.
These tokens represent Spanish noun-forming suffixes and words containing the morpheme "-ment-".
These tokens represent Spanish past participle and gerund verb suffixes varying by gender, number, and conjugation class.
This vector activates on roots and suffixes associated with socio-economic, political, and institutional terminology across multiple languages.
This vector activates for recurring subword roots and prefixes across diverse European languages.
